# Centre Street Japanese HotPot / 鼎鑽火鍋

> Official restaurant facts for Centre Street Japanese HotPot in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Taiwanese and Japanese-style individual hot pot, all-you-can-eat hot pot, Taiwanese snacks, rice and noodles, and milk tea.

- [Official website](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/)
Facts verified: 2026-11-05
Currency: Canadian dollars (CAD).

## Restaurant and location

- English name: Centre Street Japanese HotPot
- Chinese name: 鼎鑽火鍋
- Address: 2213 Centre St N #2243, Calgary, AB T2E 2T4, Canada
- Phone: +1-403-455-3188
- Email: info@centrestjhotpot.ca
- Monday–Friday: 17:00–22:30
- Saturday–Sunday: 12:00–22:30
- Dining format: each guest has an individual hot pot and chooses a soup base.
- [Source](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/restaurant-info/)
- [繁體中文官方資料](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/zh-hant/restaurant-info/)

## Dining options and prices

| Option | Price | Includes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-You-Can-Eat Hot Pot / 火鍋吃到飽 | $28.99 per adult | One of 15 soup bases. AAA beef, lamb, pork or chicken ordered through the server. |
| Personal Hot Pot / 個人火鍋 | $19.99 | One soup base, a large vegetable set, one meat and one rice or noodle side. |
| 19 AYCE Snacks Upgrade / 19 款小吃任點升級 | +$5.99 per person | Optional upgrade for AYCE diners. Everyone at the same table must upgrade. |
| Solo Hot Pot Combo / 單人套餐 | $24.99 | One personal hot pot and one drink. |
| Couple Hot Pot Combo / 雙人套餐 | $58.99 | Two personal hot pots, two drinks and one appetizer. |

- AYCE children's prices by height: under 100 cm free; 100–140 cm $12.99; over 140 cm adult price.
- Split pot upgrade: +$2.
- Golden Fried Buns / 黃金炸饅頭: $6.89 when ordered à la carte. This is separate from the AYCE snack upgrade.
- [Menu and prices](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/menu/)
- [AYCE inclusions](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/ayce-hot-pot-calgary/)
- [繁體中文菜單](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/zh-hant/menu/)
- [繁體中文吃到飽](https://centrestjhotpot.ca/zh-hant/ayce-hot-pot-calgary/)

## Online reservations

- [Book online](https://reservation.centrestjhotpot.ca/book)
- Choose a date, number of guests and available time in the booking form.
- Availability is live in the booking system; this document does not provide current table availability.
- A pending request still needs restaurant approval. A reservation is confirmed only when the booking result says Confirmed.
- For large groups, urgent changes or help with booking, call +1-403-455-3188.
- 訂位結果顯示「已確認」才代表訂位成功；待確認的申請請等候餐廳確認，或在到店前致電。
